messages:
sarah: Heads-up: Planning a staged schema migration for the orders table during Tue 02:00–04:00 UTC change window. This will add column `order_flags` and run a controlled backfill. Outline below — pls review and ack.

matt: tagging infra & data ops. What's the expected lock time? :thinking_face:

sarah: We'll do the ALTER in three steps: 1) add column nullable, 2) backfill in batches via job-runner with checkpoints, 3) alter to NOT NULL. Expected exclusive lock only for the final step, targeted < 3s per shard. Snippet: 

sarah: ```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN order_flags jsonb;
-- backfill: batched updates by pk range with checkpoints
ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN order_flags SET NOT NULL;
```

linh: How large are batches? monitoring-wise we should throttle to ~2000 rows/sec to avoid DB CPU spikes. Also add circuit-breaker: abort backfill if replica lag > 30s.

sarah: Good call. Backfill runner flags: `--batch-size=2000 --max-lag=30s --checkpoint-interval=5m` and it will emit progress to metrics (`orders.backfill.progress`).

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: migrations lint OK, schema-diff none, canary image built (redwood/runner:release-2026-03-24). CI: https://ci.internal/runs/1234

jamal: We need a pinned app version for the window. I'll open a short-lived pin to `v2.9.1` across prod pods during the canary.

sarah: Rollout plan in Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/staged-migration-plan. Canary across 2 shards (~10% traffic) for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Rollback criteria: any sustained >1% 5xx or p50 latency regression >200ms for more than 5m.

irene: Data team will run a dry-run against a snapshot at 01:00 UTC. @sarah confirm snapshot restore steps and retention window.

sarah: Confirmed: snapshot created, retention 48h. Dry-run owner: @irene. We'll gate final apply on dry-run + canary pass.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. Please ping #eng-oncall when starting and at each stage change. I'll watch replica lag, CPU, and DB locks. :phone:

matt: One more: ensure the migration path doesn't take explicit table-wide locks. `ADD COLUMN` is safe, but final `ALTER ... SET NOT NULL` will require validation — we mitigate via fast check and short lock. Verify PG minor versions.

sarah: All primaries are PG 12.5 — behavior confirmed. Final checklist before apply: (1) snapshot done, (2) dry-run ok, (3) deploy pinned, (4) canary ok, (5) backfill running with throttle, (6) final alter. Anyone object?

linh: ack

jamal: ack

irene: ack

deploy-bot: scheduled migration job `mj-98765` at 2026-03-24T02:10:00Z. Will post status updates automatically.

sarah: Thanks all — will run a 30m pre-deploy standup. Invite sent. :tada:
